shortDescription: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Ltd (HKEX) HKEX:388 will add a new interest-rate swap product linked to a key Chinese money-market benchmark by year-end under its Connect Scheme, expanding hedging tools for international investors in yuan assets.

children: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Ltd (HKEX)
will add a new interest-rate swap product linked to a key Chinese money-market benchmark by year-end under its Connect Scheme, expanding hedging tools for international investors in yuan assets.
The seven-day Deposit-taking Institutions Repo Fixing Rate (FDR007) will be included in Swap Connect as a reference rate, HKEX's head of markets Gregory Yu said at an event in Shanghai on Tuesday.
The move comes as trading through Swap Connect, a platform that gives overseas investors access to China's onshore interest-rate swap market, continues to grow.

Trading volume rose 36% year-on-year in the first half of 2026, while cumulative turnover reached 14.4 trillion yuan ($2.15 trillion) by the end of August since the scheme was launched in May 2023, Yu said.

Currently, there are four fixed-for-floating interest rate swaps available on the Swap Connect, including seven-day repo (FR007), the three-month and overnight Shanghai interbank offered rate (Shibor) and the one-year Loan Prime Rate (LPR).
The new addition "will enable investors to hedge with a more accurate measure of bank liquidity and central bank policy effect than the traditional FR007," analysts at DBS wrote in a note.

China has been stepping up efforts to expand the yuan's global use through Hong Kong. The exchange launched offshore Chinese government bond futures last month, giving foreign investors a new risk-management tool.
